properties.decision: Options, from the 2026-10-19 root cause: (a) SMALL: build the line from the resolver's own list (the NamedBy sources in find()'s order), name the exact file `<root>/.reflow2.toml` with `[export] path = "…"` first because it persists for every later write, the hook, init and the gate, and --export-to second as the per-call form; pin as a class: every source find() reads appears in the line (adding a source without the line fails). (b) LARGER: sweep every refusal or hint that lists options a resolver reads (export, pointer, MCP configs) and generate each from its resolver. (c) MEDIUM: the line also gives the one command that writes the record, so the fix is one copy-paste.
properties.name: OPEN — field limitation 22: should the "no export was kept current" line be built from the sources find() actually reads, naming <project>/.reflow2.toml [export] path first?
properties.rationale: The field found .reflow2.toml works for a store outside any repo but had to find it unaided; #691 gave the export path one owner and left its explanation with two lists. Counter-argument to (b): no second instance has been measured, so the sweep may find nothing; (a) pins the class where it was seen. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
